items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You and Freddie were good pals anyway. [INTERVIEWEE] And Freddie said, 'Man, tell that man to hire me back in the band.' ... He said, 'All I do is dream about that band.'

ctx.x: Well, Paige and Basie, they had something there, didn't they? And Joe.
